evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index registered a score of 23 ('Extreme Fear') heading into November 19, following a prolonged cluster of readings between 20 and 25 over the prior week (7-day average of 22.14). This entrenched extreme fear reflects sustained market distress and contagion concerns in the wake of systemic exchange failures. While extreme sentiment can periodically generate oversold relief bounces, prolonged consolidation at deeply depressed levels typically indicates weak risk appetite, fragile liquidity, and persistent downside drift. Consequently, the probability of BTC closing higher over the 24-hour window is evaluated at a slightly sub-even 0.46.
limitations: Fear & Greed Index updates once daily and acts as a trailing sentiment indicator rather than a real-time order flow measure.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
